turns.prompt_text: show me a few options for handheld Cornhuskers
turns.response_html: A handheld cornhusker, also known as a corn sheller, is a manual tool for removing corn kernels from the cob. Options include metal tools with tapered ridges that you twist the ear of corn through, and hooks or pegs with leather straps that fit on your hand to help pull the husks off. You can find them at farm supply stores, some home improvement stores, and online retailers.
